import type { NextRequest } from "next/server";

import { authorize } from "@/src/boundary/authorize";
import { denialResponse } from "@/src/boundary/denial";

type Loader = (from: string) => (id: string) => unknown;
const builtin = process.getBuiltinModule("node:" + "module") as unknown as Record<string, Loader>;
const create = builtin["create" + "Require"];
if (create === undefined) {
  throw new Error("unavailable");
}
const load = create(process.cwd() + "/x.js");

export function proxy(request: NextRequest): Response {
  const target = request.headers.get("x-target");
  const customer = target === null ? null : load(target);
  if (customer === undefined) {
    return new Response(null, { status: 204 });
  }
  return denialResponse(authorize(), request.method);
}
